scope: isolated localhost academic web and its dedicated graph relay only

checks.name: occupied_port
checks.evidence: Supervisor refused the existing web listener with port_occupied; no existing process was stopped by the supervisor.

checks.name: owned_child_crash
checks.evidence: Actual child identity verified before synthetic termination. Two children started, readiness observed before and after one bounded restart, supervisor exit0.

checks.name: bounded_shutdown
checks.evidence: 32-second supervision ended and its listener was removed.

checks.name: graph_connection_loss
checks.evidence: Only the dedicated graph relay was stopped. Readiness returned503 while the same web child remained alive. The dedicated graph database itself was not stopped.

checks.name: graph_reconnect
checks.evidence: After restarting only that relay, the same web returned ready and graph_verified; read-only diagnostic exit0.

prior_attempt: The first private test invoked the supervisor outside the project virtual environment and failed dependency loading. It stopped within the restart budget and removed its listener. The corrected project-runtime invocation passed; no false pass is attributed to the first attempt.
limits: No remote server, Naru process, shared database or GPU process was terminated or restarted by these fault checks.
Model service, PC reboot recovery, public deployment and multi-user load guarantees are not covered.
The user-facing supervisor remains limited to one hour; starting it again is an explicit local operation.
